Stratum is an open-source two factor authentication app for Android. It features encrypted backups, icons, categories and a high level of customization. It also has a Wear OS companion app.
 It supports TOTP (Time Based) and HOTP (Counter Based) authenticators using either SHA1, SHA256 or SHA512 hashing algorithms. Mobile-Otp (mOTP), Steam and Yandex are also supported.
 2 Factor authentication provides an extra layer of security to your accounts by requiring the use of a one time code to log in. In addition to your username and password, you will need a code provided by Stratum. So even if your login details are compromised, your account remains safe.
 Features 
 ⚙️ Compatibility : Stratum is compatible with most providers and accounts.
 📲 Import : Easily migrate your accounts to Stratum from supported alternative apps.
 💾 Backup / Restore : Backup your authenticators with strong encryption. In case you lose or change your phone, you can always gain access to your accounts. You can save backups to cloud storage or to your device.
 🌙 Dark Mode : Stratum has a beautiful material design inspired look in either light or dark themes.
 ⏺️ Icons : Find your authenticators easily with recognizable brand logos and icons next to each code.
 📂 Categories : Organize your authenticators into categories.
 🔒 Offline with few permissions : Stratum only requires a single permission¹ and does not require Internet access to function.
 🔑 Security : Set a password and use biometric authentication to protect your codes.
 🎨 Customization : Set icons and rename. You can also arrange your authenticators in any order you like so you can find them easily.
 ⌚ Wear OS : Quickly view your authenticators directly from your watch. You can even set a favorite and place it in a tile. Please note that a connection to your Android device is required. Furthermore, F-Droid distributions of the app are not compatible with Wear OS, since non-free dependencies are required.

fdroid:io.oversec.one.name: Oversec
fdroid:io.oversec.one.summary: Privacy for All Apps! Encrypt and Disguise Messages in All Your Apps!
fdroid:io.oversec.one.description:
Oversec transparently encrypts and decrypts any text in any app 
You can use it to exchange private encrypted and covert chat- or email messages or store your own encrypted notes on your phone.
See our demo videos:
* Introduction 
* Encrypting Emails 
* Encrypting Images 
Oversec is completely agnostic of the subjacent app, it works with Whatsapp™, Line™, Snapchat™, Instagram™ or any other chat app. It also supports sending and receiving PGP encrypted messages with the Gmail™ or any other Email app.
End-to-End Encryption was yesterday. Oversec introduces "Eye-to-Eye" encryption. Encrypted data is only decrypted while it is shown on the screen! No clear text is ever persisted and thus cannot be extracted from the file system or accidentally be backed up into the cloud.
We also carefully designed Oversec so that it doesn't require internet access. Because of that, you can rest assured that no decrypted information can ever leave your device.
 How it works: 
Oversec constantly monitors the text on your screen. When it finds an encrypted text, it tries to decrypt it and then shows the decrypted text as an overlay in place of the encrypted text. Conversely, it can read text out of an input field, encrypt it, and then put the encrypted text back into the input field.
In order to encrypt a text, Oversec shows a button next to an active input field. After having entered the secret text, tapping that button makes Oversec read the text, encrypt it and put back the encrypted text into the field. It is now ready to be sent in the subjacent app as usual - the app doesn't even know that it is sending encrypted data!
Oversec also features a unique way of encoding the encrypted messages. It stores the encrypted text in invisible (zero-width) characters and let's you add decoy text at the end. That way, a message will just show e.g. "The sun is shining!" with no visible sign of any encryption, whereas in reality it contains a hidden encrypted message.
You may also encrypt and send photos through Oversec - its unique camera mode even allows you to take and send an encrypted photo without ever storing the original photo on the device.
Oversec encrypts your data either using symmetric keys (using ChaCha20 cipher + Poly1305 MAC ) or using asymmetric PGP encryption (making use of the OpenKeychain app).
The code is open source and can be found here .
This app uses Accessibility services.

File Transfer:

flathub:me.fouquet.Stencil.name: Stencil
flathub:me.fouquet.Stencil.description:
Stencil is a batch file (and directory) renamer for GNOME. Build a rename queue from
 stackable operations and preview every result before you commit.
 Operations include:
 Number - add a sequential counter
 Set Extension - change, normalize or remove the extension
 Insert Text - add text before, after or at a position
 Find & Replace - literal or regular-expression replacement
 Change Case - lower, upper, title or sentence case
 Trim & Remove - drop characters and clean up whitespace
 Date & Time - prefix or suffix a formatted timestamp
 Music Tags - build names from embedded audio tags (artist, title, album, track number, …) using a token pattern like {track} - {title}
 Image Tags - build names from Exif metadata (capture date, camera, lens, dimensions, exposure settings, …) using a token pattern like {year}-{month}-{day} {camera}
 Video Tags - build names from video container metadata (recording date, resolution, duration, codec) using a token pattern like {year}-{month}-{day} {width}x{height}
 Folder Name - insert the name of a containing folder, from the immediate parent up to any number of levels

firefox-addons:3044649.name: Adblock
firefox-addons:3044649.summary: Adblock: A lightweight, permissionless and user-friendly ad blocker for ads, trackers and malware.
firefox-addons:3044649.description:
Adblock blocks ads and trackers before they are even requested.
WHY IT'S FAST
A static network filtering engine indexes every filter under its most
discriminating token, so out of 120,000+ filters, only a handful are ever
evaluated per request. Average matching latency: ~11 microseconds.
WHAT IT BLOCKS
• Ad and tracker network requests (EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uAssets, Liste FR)
• Ad placeholders, via CSS element hiding
• YouTube video ads, via scriptlets that strip ad metadata from the player
• Tracking parameters in URLs (fbclid, gclid, utm_*, and 120 more)
BUILT NOT TO BREAK SITES
Cosmetic rules are validated before use: any selector able to reach the
document root or match arbitrary elements is rejected. Generic rules are
served on demand, based on the classes actually present in the page,
instead of being dumped wholesale onto every site.
PRIVACY
No accounts, no analytics, no telemetry, no data collection of any kind.
Everything runs locally on your device.

The sidebar opens with the subtitles. 2. Pick the language you hear (or leave it on Auto) and the language you want to read. 3. Subtitles appear word by word, about a second after the words are spoken. On the first start the extension downloads its speech recognition model (about 440 MB) once, and a small translation model for each language pair you use. After that it starts right away and works offline. Features • Real-time audio translation: speech is transcribed and translated while it plays, not after the video ends. • Any audio in the tab: videos, live streams, video calls, podcasts, online courses and webinars on any website. • Video calls in the browser: Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams in a Firefox tab. • Sidebar or overlay: read the subtitles in the sidebar next to the page, or turn on the overlay to show them on top of the video, also in full screen. Drag it, resize it and pick the text size. • Autosave to a file: every session can be written to a text file in your Downloads folder, a ready transcript of the call, lecture or video. • 33 spoken languages, 39 subtitle languages, and any pair between them. • Auto-detect: leave the audio language on Auto and the extension works out what is being spoken. • Live transcription: choose the same language on both sides to get a real-time transcript instead of a translation. • Private by design: audio never leaves your device. No sign-up, no API key, no subscription, no tracking. Languages Speech is recognized in 33 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Slovak, Slovenian, Croatian, Bulgarian, Romanian, Hungarian, Greek, Lithuanian, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian (Bokmål and Nynorsk), Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai and Vietnamese. Subtitles can be shown in all of them, and also in Bengali, Indonesian, Kannada, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu and Traditional Chinese. Where it works • YouTube and other video sites, including videos without captions • Movies and series in the browser • Live streams and live events • Video calls and meetings in the browser • Podcasts, interviews and radio • Online courses, lectures and webinars FAQ Is my audio sent anywhere? No. Audio is processed on your computer and never leaves it. The extension has no servers of its own, no analytics and no ads. Why does it ask for access to websites? To hear the audio of the tab you click the icon on, and to show the overlay on top of the page. Page content is not collected or sent anywhere. What do I need? Firefox 142 or newer on desktop. No graphics card is needed. Can it translate the whole system audio or several tabs at once? It listens to one tab at a time. Click the icon on another tab to switch. Other versions • Chrome and other Chromium browsers, on the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/audio-translator/phnegjcmilllfibjapkpolnfiifcjhcb • Android phones, on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.audiotranslator Website: https://audio-translator.mbplanes.com/

firefox-addons:3037837.name: Notte — Accessibility & Dark Mode
firefox-addons:3037837.summary: An accessibility toolkit for low vision. Dark mode with guaranteed contrast, plus bigger text, wider spacing, a clearer font, warm tint and reduced motion. Any site. Free, open source, no tracking.
firefox-addons:3037837.description:
Notte turns bright, glaring websites dark — and gives you the controls to make
any page readable.
Born from necessity: the developer lives with a degenerative eye condition, and
white screens can be genuinely painful for people with low vision, light
sensitivity or eye strain. Notte was built first and foremost as an
accessibility tool, and it will always be completely free: no ads, no
subscriptions, no donations asked.
HOW IT WORKS
Notte doesn't invert colours. It reads the page's stylesheets and remaps every
background to a deep, consistent dark tone and every text to a bright, readable
one, always keeping a high contrast ratio (WCAG-friendly). Colours keep their
identity — buttons, links and highlights stay recognisable — while photos and
videos remain untouched, in their natural colours.
THE TOOLKIT
Dark mode is the entry point, not the whole tool. Every setting below works per
site, on darkened pages and on ordinary bright ones:
 Guaranteed contrast — a target you set, not a slider you have to tune
 Text size, letter and word spacing, line spacing
 Warm tint to cut blue light
 Brightness, saturation and image dimming
 Underline every link, strong keyboard focus outlines
 Reduce motion, for vestibular disorders and migraine
Notte leaves sites that already ship a proper dark mode alone, and every control
in the popup is large and high-contrast — an accessibility tool you need good
eyesight to operate is a contradiction.
PRIVACY
Notte collects nothing. No data, no analytics, no tracking, no account. Your
browsing never leaves your device. Notte asks for site access for one reason
only: some stylesheets are blocked by the browser's cross-origin rules, so a
background script re-fetches them in order to darken them. That script stores
nothing and sends nothing anywhere.
Notte runs on Firefox for desktop and Firefox for Android, and is also available
for Chrome and for Safari on Mac, iPhone and iPad, from a single open source
codebase.
Open source under the MIT licence. If a website doesn't look right, feedback is always welcome — it helps make the web more readable for everyone.

firefox-addons:3029482.name: Accesserty DevCheck: Accessibility Checker
firefox-addons:3029482.summary: Check pages and PDFs for accessibility in your browser: WCAG scans, focus order, headings, forms, and vision and tremor simulations.
firefox-addons:3029482.description:
Accesserty DevCheck checks accessibility on the page you are actually reviewing: a staging build, a signed-in view, a CMS preview, localhost, or a local PDF. Everything except the optional AI Check runs in your browser.
Made for anyone who reviews pages before release: designers, PMs, QA, content editors, and engineers. No account and no accessibility background needed.
Try it first on the practice page, a fictional demo with deliberate issues and a one-click fix: https://accesserty.com/en/devcheck-practice/ 
SCAN THE PAGE
• Run automated axe-core checks for WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A/AA rules plus best practices. They find issues a machine can detect; AAA is not checked in full.
• See confirmed issues separately from items that need a person to judge, jump to each affected element, and copy a text summary into your own issue tracker.
SEE THE STRUCTURE
Review lenses draw the page's structure on top of it, so you can judge it yourself:
• Focus Path: keyboard focus order with numbered markers and hints for possible jumps.
• Headings: the h1–h6 outline, including headings only screen readers hear.
• Landmarks: header, nav, main and other regions, with hints for missing or duplicated ones.
• Accessible names: hover or Tab to an element to see its role, name, and where the name comes from.
• Reading preview: the page in reading order, read aloud with your device's own voices.
• Forms: labels, descriptions and error messages connected to each field. "Try submitting" watches how the page reports errors after you press its own submit button. DevCheck never submits a form itself.
• Stop motion: pauses animations and video, then marks what still moves.
EXPERIENCE THE BARRIERS
• Color vision differences, low vision, visual field loss, text spacing, dyslexia-like reading difficulty, and touch target conflicts.
• A screen magnifier (×2, ×3, ×4) that follows your mouse and keyboard focus.
• Hand tremor: the cursor shakes and clicks land where it shakes, so small or crowded targets get missed. A panel counts the misses.
• Silent mode: mutes the tab, tells you each time the page makes a sound, and lists media without captions.
CHECK PDFS
• Check a local PDF for document language, tags, bookmarks, links, images and form fields. The file never leaves your device. Results are structure signals, not PDF/UA conformance.
AI CHECK (OPTIONAL)
• Review link purpose, language marking and image alt text quality, with suggested alt text.
WHAT DEVCHECK IS NOT
DevCheck does not replace manual review or testing with assistive technology. Orange marks are things to review, not confirmed WCAG failures. It helps you find common issues earlier and discuss them with concrete context.
PRIVACY
Scans, review lenses, simulations and PDF checks run locally and send nothing. The reading preview uses only voices installed on your device.
AI Check runs only when you start it. It sends a bounded sample of visible text, link names (which can include visually hidden accessible names and CSS-clipped text), and images the page allows the extension to read to Google Gemini. With your own Gemini API key, the sample goes directly to Google. Without one, it goes through Accesserty's free proxy, which also receives a random installation ID and derives an IP hash to enforce daily limits. Content inside open shadow roots is included, but AI Check does not traverse frames or closed shadow roots. DevCheck does not send the full page, browsing history, form values, PDF files or scan results, and it omits dedicated URL fields, though URLs inside sampled content may still be sent. Under Google's unpaid-service terms, inputs and outputs may be used to improve Google's products and may be seen by human reviewers, so do not submit confidential, unauthorized or personal content to AI Check. Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms 
Reports you copy or download are created locally and may include the page URL and sampled text.
PRICE
All local tools are free. Shared AI Check has daily and rate limits; your own key follows Google's quotas and pricing.
Learn more: https://accesserty.com/en/devcheck/ 
Privacy policy: https://accesserty.com/en/privacy/

iA Writer is the original Markdown writing app. Keep your hands on the keys and your mind in the text. No buttons, no popups, no title bar. Write first, format later.

iA Writer is not yet another layout program. It’s an app designed for writing and nothing else. iA Writer has less features and more focus. It doesn’t fill the screen with fonts, styles and toolbars. Every function deepens the focus.
# Hyperfocus
Focus Mode dims everything but the current sentence or paragraph, keeping you in the flow. It helps you re-feel, re-think, and re-write your text until it says exactly what you mean.
# Authorship
Did you write this? Or Claude? iA Writer tracks and shows what you wrote and what you pasted. Your words speak in black and white. AI stands out in technicolor. As you type, you make it your own. Don’t let AI speak for you.
# The Elements of Style
Cut noise, think clearly. Style Check flags clichés and clutter. You decide what to cut and what to keep. It helps you put everything in its right place.
# Super Simple
Structure text with Markdown. Embed links, photos, and tables, and see them in preview. Export to PDF, to Word, and to HTML. Your file stays in plain text and works everywhere. Quick Search offers outline and fast access to other documents.
# The Original Writing App
For 16 years, iA Writer has earned awards and praise. Four-time App of the Year winner and 2025 Apple Design Award finalist. Over three million writers have used it to focus on their words.
“Beautiful. The gold standard for Markdown.” — John Gruber, creator of Markdown
“A clean, simple and distraction-free environment for when you really need to focus on your words.” — The New York Times
“A scalpel in a world of Swiss army knives. Powerful simplicity.” — The Guardian
"Leaving life's mess for an ideal realm of words." — The New Yorker
“Everything goes away except for the writing experience.” — Stephen Fry, actor and writer
“It is tiny but it is huge. ” — Augusten Burroughs, bestselling author
Try it for free for seven days.
# Get in Touch
Visit ia.net/writer for more information.
Visit ia.net/writer/support for support and feedback.

apple-itunes:327538172.description:
HelloMind helps you battle problems like stress, bad sleep, weight gain and low self-esteem. Choose a treatment, then relax and listen to the sessions. 
HelloMind helps you take back control from negative emotions, cravings, fears and bad habits and it can improve your motivation and enjoyment of life. 
Try the Sleep Boosters:
- Have a good night’s sleep
- Sleep more peacefully
Or boost your confidence with the sessions:
- Have more confidence
- Improve your self-worth
- Become self-confident
Or kick that anxiety for good with sessions like:
- Be more calm
- Get rid of your fear of panicking
- My ability to de-stress
Or get rid of your phobia eg.:
- Spiders
- Dentists
- Enclosed spaces
MORE
Low self-esteem, stress, fear, bad sleep and unhealthy habits sometimes hold us back in life and prevent us from enjoying things to the fullest. 
The good news is these negative patterns can be broken or eliminated. 
We created the HelloMind app to help you make a change. We want you to be able to think better and feel stronger. Anywhere, any time without having to spend a lot of time and money on treatment. 
The key to happiness lies within you. And HelloMind works because you are making the change yourself. 
Choose a treatment with 10 sessions if you want help to remove or change something like a craving, a habit or a fear. Each session takes about 30 minutes, and your series of 10 sessions should be completed within about 30 days.
Choose a Booster if you’d like to reinforce good emotions boost motivation or strengthen a certain area of yourself.
HelloMind uses a method called RDH - Result Driven Hypnosis, a form of guided hypnosis.

apple-macos:6446505967.description:
MIDI Messenger is an AUv3 MIDI plug-in that came to life as an answer to the lack of MIDI processors for iOS.
It allows creating an endless list of ‘messages’ that will be sent after being triggered by incoming MIDI or system events. MIDI messages can be typed in manually or contain some expression calculations allowing generative workflows.
Here's the list of possible triggers: On Load, CC, Note On, Note Off, MIDI/AU Host Transport Start/Stop/Continue, Pressure.
Here are possible message types: CC, Program/Bank Change, Note On, Note Off, Pressure, Pitch Wheel, Sysex, All Sounds Off (CC).
Messages have order, the first message to be triggered and sent is at the top of the list. The last one is at the bottom.
You can specify a delay time in milliseconds so the message is sent a bit later than the trigger-event was detected. You can discard incoming messages that triggered new messages, or pass them through. You can also reorder messages.
